# Streetshow Productions

> Strategy-first creative production studio based in Fukuoka and Tokyo, Japan. Streetshow Productions helps premium international brands enter and perform in Japan, and helps Japanese brands scale globally through live commerce and Shopify growth systems. Founded 2013. Bilingual (English / Japanese) team operating across Japan, France, and Kigali.

## About

Streetshow Productions is a boutique creative production studio that blends business strategy, cultural localization, and high-end production across video, photography, CGI, 3D anamorphic billboards, and live commerce. The studio was founded in 2013 by Daxtel Jackson (Director, Strategist, and Videographer). Streetshow operates bilingually in English and Japanese and works with luxury hospitality, fashion, automotive, F&B, and e-commerce brands.

- **Founded:** 2013
- **Founder:** Daxtel Jackson
- **Headquarters:** Fukuoka, Japan
- **Secondary office:** Tokyo, Japan
- **Languages:** English, Japanese
- **Areas served:** Japan, United States, Europe
- **Contact:** admin@streetshowproduction.com · +81-70-4801-1725
- **Website:** https://streetshowproduction.com

## What we do

Streetshow Productions offers six core services. Each is listed below with the canonical page URL and a brief description.

### Japan Market Entry & Localization
https://streetshowproduction.com/services/japan-market-localization
Strategy-first cultural adaptation, messaging, and creative execution for international brands launching in Japan. Not translation — transcreation and positioning aligned with Japanese market expectations.

### Luxury Hospitality Creative Strategy & Production
https://streetshowproduction.com/services/hospitality-creative-strategy-japan
Creative strategy, video, and photography production for luxury hotels, resorts, and destination properties in Japan. Built to support booking intent and premium brand perception.

### Video Production in Japan
https://streetshowproduction.com/services/video-production-japan
Full-service video production in Japan — commercials, brand films, social content, documentaries. Local crew, bilingual operation, international quality standards.

### Photography & CGI
https://streetshowproduction.com/services/photography-cgi-japan
High-end product, editorial, hospitality, and CGI visualization across Japan. Premium visual systems for advertising, e-commerce, and brand campaigns.

### 3D Anamorphic Billboards in Japan
https://streetshowproduction.com/services/3d-anamorphic-billboards-japan
Naked-eye 3D billboard production for Shibuya, Shinjuku, and other high-visibility LED screens across Japan. Concept, 3D animation, and screen-specific calibration.

### Live Commerce & Shopify Growth — Japan to Global
https://streetshowproduction.com/services/live-commerce-growth-japan
Live commerce, Shopify DTC, community building, email lifecycle, paid media, and cross-border US/EU wholesale acquisition. Built for Japanese brands scaling globally and for DTC brands adopting live selling.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does Streetshow Productions do?**
Streetshow Productions is a strategy-first creative production studio based in Fukuoka and Tokyo, Japan. The studio helps international premium brands enter and perform in the Japanese market through cultural localization, video production, photography, CGI, 3D anamorphic billboards, and live commerce growth systems.

**Where is Streetshow Productions based?**
Streetshow Productions is headquartered in Fukuoka, Japan, with a secondary office in Tokyo. The team operates bilingually in English and Japanese and serves clients across Japan, the United States, and Europe.

**When was Streetshow Productions founded?**
Streetshow Productions was founded in 2013 by Daxtel Jackson, who serves as Director, Strategist, and Videographer.

**Who does Streetshow Productions work with?**
Streetshow Productions has worked with New Balance Japan, SHEIN Japan, The Ritz-Carlton Kyoto, The Ritz-Carlton Osaka, Charles & Keith, KUOE Kyoto, SOUMEI Champagne, QC Running, FUDITALYCO, and JTL Kabushiki Gaisha, among others.

**What is Japan market entry and how does Streetshow approach it?**
Japan market entry is the process of launching a foreign brand into the Japanese consumer market. Streetshow approaches it strategy-first: brand positioning, cultural adaptation (not translation), pricing logic for Japanese buyers, creative transcreation, and locally-calibrated launch production. The studio focuses on luxury hospitality, fashion, automotive, F&B, and e-commerce.

**Does Streetshow produce 3D anamorphic billboards in Shibuya?**
Yes. Streetshow Productions produces naked-eye 3D anamorphic billboard content for Shibuya, Shinjuku, and other high-visibility LED locations across Japan. Scope includes concept, 3D animation, and screen-specific calibration.

**Does Streetshow work bilingually in English and Japanese?**
Yes. All production, strategy, and client communication can be delivered in English or Japanese. Every deliverable is built to perform in the Japanese market while remaining legible to international stakeholders.

**How do I contact Streetshow Productions?**
Email admin@streetshowproduction.com or call +81-70-4801-1725. Project inquiries can also be submitted via https://streetshowproduction.com/contact.
